ex: The report gives a comprehensive overview.

mistake.wrong: The teacher was very comprehensive with me.
mistake.right: The teacher was very understanding with me.
mistake.note: comprehensive means complete. Understanding (sympathetic) is a different word.

senses.def: something that you agree to do or give to someone in order to end an argument
ex: Both sides made concessions to reach an agreement.

senses.def: the act of admitting that something is true, especially in an argument
ex: A good essay makes a concession before rejecting the other view.

senses.def: short and clear, expressing what needs to be said without unnecessary words
ex: a concise summary of the report
Our research was constrained by funding.
Growth is constrained by a lack of skilled workers.

senses.def: to force someone to do something
ex: I felt constrained to tell her the truth.
